selection: Choose by actual scope, user time constraints and available evidence, not by discipline name.

quick.use_for: Single explanation, short translation, local polish or narrowly scoped lookup.
quick.behavior: Load only the selected workflow's necessary modules; perform applicable checks locally without a full dossier. Persist version-bound receipts if recording a reusable pass.

standard.use_for: Multi-step work, analytical visuals, manuscript/booklet alignment or reusable delivery.
standard.behavior: Record scope, versioned inputs, protections, actual outputs and receipts; inspect the relevant exported artifacts.

deep.use_for: Substantive research, major argument changes or consequential cross-artifact review.
deep.behavior: Add contrary explanations and targeted verification within an explicit task budget; do not spawn subagents without authorization or repeat unaffected stages.

unavailable_cost_fields: Use null unless the host exposes actual token usage or monetary cost.
